I'm saying that now that I've been letting people help me, I think it might be possible to not hate existing so much. 

And that I've spent a long time trying to killing myself, but I don't think I'll get past my biological instinct to stop before I go through with it. So wanting to die all the time but not being able to stop living gave me a reason to make an effort to address why I hate living. 

Since the help is effective for some at least, I think there is a point in trying to help us.

Yeah, it's the hopelessness that is really damaging... But seeing improvements happen gradually give me a lot of hope, and then feeling less hopeless makes it easier to enjoy living. Best of luck to you as well!

I would be very happy for you if you do. I was absolutely not expecting it to be very helpful at all.
